question: On eight fixed unplanted P-256 labelled bases and separate constructed controls, does the m=4 point-only shared-coordinate join enumerate exactly the signed quadruple relations found by separate Jacobian exhaustive arithmetic, and what exact dependency/useful counts occur?

claims.text: For each completed fixed case, the complete m=4 MITM relation list equals the separate Jacobian exhaustive list, and every emitted relation has checked point and modulo-r label semantics.
The retained fixed unplanted-case dependency counts and constructed-control outcomes describe only these domains; no natural-yield distribution, speedup or unknown-log attack claim is made.

arms.description: Candidate shared-coordinate pair join over all ten fixed internal cases. One arm execution spans the entire frozen case panel; input construction and postprocessing are shared explicitly with the exhaustive arm.
Separate complete Jacobian signed-quadruple enumeration over exactly the same ten fixed internal cases. This is a correctness reference, not a performance reference.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic identity/list comparisons have no noisy primary clock or statistical arm difference; the separate Jacobian exhaustive oracle checks every finite-domain relation. Diagnostic clocks are never evidence.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Embedded constructed-useful and constructed-zero-Q cases run through the same point-only solver and independent complete oracle; the designated planted tuple must be found, and its B!=0 or A=B=0 outcome must check. They are internal cases of the full-panel units shared by both algorithm arms.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Embedded forged-label, off-curve, duplicate-x, overlap, wrong-sign, integer-mod-r and declared-premise controls exercise actual refusal/assessment paths. The eight unplanted deterministic SHA fixtures are retained without asserting an expected empty outcome; they do not sample a statistical null population.

instance_sampling.rule: Exactly eight unplanted public hash-to-point targets and independently tagged deterministic a,b labels; four partitions of8 globally distinct-x points; separate constructed controls. This deterministic fixture law is not asserted to be independent-uniform sampling.

blinding.how: Exact fixture identities and positive/refusal controls are public and unmasked; only descriptive counts and equality checks are reported.

power.note: No inferential test or rare-yield estimate. Every declared signed quadruple is enumerated in each completed finite domain. The fixed eight unplanted cases exercise input variety and do not establish statistical power for rare dependencies.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: No pilot arithmetic run has occurred.110 seconds is an advisory engineering allowance beneath the115-second in-process checkpoint watchdog, not a measurement or mathematical runtime bound.

primary.name: Completed internal cases
primary.definition: Number of ten declared internal cases whose complete source/oracle/label checks finished.

primary.name: Completed unplanted cases
primary.definition: Number of eight fixed unplanted cases that completely finished.

primary.name: Unplanted dependencies
primary.definition: All signed partition-compatible zero sums recorded in completed unplanted cases.

primary.name: Verified unplanted useful dependencies
primary.definition: Recorded unplanted relations whose B is nonzero and recovered scalar verifies dG=Q.

primary.name: Constructed useful-control dependencies
primary.definition: Verified useful relations in deliberately constructed cases; generation witness already known.

primary.name: Constructed zero-Q dependencies
primary.definition: Relations in deliberately constructed cases with A=B=0.

primary.name: Independent exhaustive signed quadruples
primary.definition: Signed index quadruples visited by separate Jacobian oracle across completed cases; enumeration count, not group-equivalent cost. Zero in the MITM arm denotes an unused enumeration path, not an observed empty relation set.

primary.name: MITM pair evaluations
primary.definition: Left plus right signed pair evaluations in completed cases, excluding setup, validations, labels and oracle; native omitted-stage counters retained. Zero in the exhaustive arm denotes an unused MITM path, not a cost advantage.

primary.name: Completed refusal/premise checks
primary.definition: Embedded refusal and declared-premise checks completed after the fixed case panel.

stopping_rules.rule: One fixed full panel:8 natural cases of four8-point partitions, useful control, zero-Q control and listed refusals. No success-dependent stopping.
A wrong relation/oracle mismatch/control failure records a failed panel and all earlier completed cases; later cases remain not completed, never mathematical emptiness.
115-second in-process checkpoint watchdog retains partial event journals and a timeout row;120-second external guard or memory interruption remains unknown if a process cannot finish its receipt.

invalidation_rules: Any wrong relation, label, recovered scalar or oracle disagreement invalidates the full-panel verification.
Incomplete cases are unknown and are excluded from complete-domain observations. All raw partial counters and failures remain available.
Wall/CPU clocks on this shared host are diagnostic only; wall_valid=false.
No hidden statistical claim, source mutation after freeze, seed substitution, favourable-case selection or omitted failed attempt is admissible.

decision_rule.text: Report exact retained relation lists/counts for completed fixed cases and whether complete list equality, label arithmetic and embedded controls verified. Any failed control or interrupted execution is failed/inconclusive within this panel; no scientific state transition or performance conclusion. The two arms share input construction, postprocessing and diagnostic process resources; no independent method clock/cost comparison is admitted.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact list equality and valid point/label certificates; no statistical threshold.
decision_rule.statistic: Recorded complete finite relation lists and exact event/object counts.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: not applicable; no comparative effect claim

graphs: Exact per-case dependencies and verified useful dependencies; controls explicitly labelled constructed.
